[[Poisonbough]] is a [[Pinesoul]] [[boss]] in the [[Lornar's Pass]].

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Lornar's Pass}}

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Determined Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Barbed Trap}}
* {{skill icon|Muddy Terrain}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Alpine Seed]]

== Notes ==
* Usually found with 3 or 4 [[Ice Imp]]s, and is very hard to kill with the low level [[henchmen]] from [[Beacon's Perch]].
* Poisonbough can be most easily found by entering Lornar's Pass from Beacon's Perch. He will be just off-radar to the left, on top of the hill. He shares this spawning location with [[Quickroot]] and [[Clobberhusk]], so it may be necessary to zone a few times in order to find him.
* Not only does he share three spawn locations with two other bosses, he also shares them with regular Pinesouls, so there may not be a boss present at one location at all.

== Trivia ==
* The reason why this boss doesn't have an [[elite skill]] is because [[Muddy Terrain]] was an elite skill during the beta of Prophecies.
